notes.title: Game core optimization and island map generation changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/f0af760a649aba4f52187a47acbed2330cd65637.jpg[/img]

Hi friends! We’ve released a small but important update.

We’ve significantly optimized the game’s core gameplay systems.
Additionally, island maps will now appear less frequently in team matches.
On island maps, it’s now guaranteed that at least 10% of the map area consists of uninhabited islands.

Thank you for playing and supporting us - especially for your feedback and replays. We’ll keep polishing performance and the map generator!
Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Italy is preparing for release. A brief overview of the units.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/6cda6830fd94f6f746815b67a16490675217f518.jpg[/img]

The new nation, Italy, is in the final stages of production.
We will introduce you to the units that will soon be at your disposal.

[b]Let’s start with the forces of the First Industrial Revolution.[/b]

Among the light troops, the assault group stands out.

The highly maneuverable and fast Guzzi Alce motorcycle, paired with the brave armored stormtroopers, Arditi, pose a serious threat to enemy infantry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/9d6371b52651d1ff5ba6142390dfd6529abecc35.gif[/img]


Meanwhile, an infantryman equipped with the Brixia automatic grenade launcher can fire multiple grenades in a single burst while remaining a mobile and lightweight unit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/c20a36a7abbb260bce77dd0989d3b31e9556bff4.gif[/img]


The classic Italian light and fast armored vehicle, Terni, comes armed with a rapid-fire machine gun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/4e0006701f3a3b3ca682c7462f0add3d45123773.png[/img]


Someone might say that the light tank F3000 seems oddly familiar, but we’d answer that it’s not the shape that matters—what matters is who built the machine and the soul they put into it. We are renowned not for the memories of our ancestors but for the deeds of their children.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/3303e17cff7ad2596951b738f5d48e904d1e44ab.png[/img]


The monstrous D.S. Howitzer rolls onto the battlefield as a terrifying piece of heavy artillery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/2df91452df3ba8d2339532cf4fc24fc39309c584.png[/img]


The magnificent heavy bomber, Caproni Ca.3, can cover impressive distances for its time while carrying a deadly payload.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/5cf9830b82b5c7eb09a86e7e5b0aabe546b198ab.png[/img]


[b]The forces of the Second Industrial Revolution bring even more weight to Italy’s presence on the battlefield.[/b]


Equipped with a powerful engine and a fearsome rapid-firing cannon, the AB 41 armored car can not only deliver infantry to the battlefield but also provide cover during combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/0a49f43dae487720499e326e3bdb8cd6e0f52232.png[/img]


The medium-heavy tank M13 40 confidently takes on the role of a versatile combat vehicle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/5e861f6765ac7b8c8d7d68170b721bdab050e764.png[/img]


The queen of long-range artillery may not fire often, but every shot she takes reaps a rich harvest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/e7d36af1997589cd077bf897327bf06981f9aecb.gif[/img]


The heavy bomber, Caproni Ca.132, proudly continues the legacy of its predecessor by delivering death and destruction to enemy positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/37774f402a39e65830d7470a5863a5513d1b1019.png[/img]


In addition to these forces, Italy offers several other exciting opportunities.

Stay tuned for our news.

notes.title: Changes in the dynamics of rating gains for 1v1 and 2v2 matches!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/00974cd3ec26af1ea98625ad4cac50d4c9809734.jpg[/img]

Changes have been made to the rating system for 1v1 and 2v2 matches!
The dynamics of rating point gains and losses have been updated.

At the start of the season, rating changes will be doubled — instead of the usual 30 rating points, you can now gain or lose up to 60 rating points per match. This will allow you to climb the leaderboards faster and have a greater impact on your ranking from the very first games.

However, as the end of the season approaches, the rewards and penalties for 1v1 and 2v2 matches will decrease. The closer we get to the end of the season, the less your rating will change.

Step into battle confidently and take control of your path to the top of the rankings from the very first matches of the season!

Good luck on the battlefields!

notes.title: Bug fixes

	Main:

		- If the time zone could not be determined, the game would not start
		- Fixed various network bugs that could lead to issues with reconnecting to the game

		- Sometimes the system of determining the harm to an ally was falsely triggered
		- Small impassable areas of terrain could appear during combat

		- When changing the replay speed, the fog of war animation did not change its speed

notes.title: Austria-Hungary is getting ready to release.
notes.notes:
Austria-Hungary is almost done. We are planning to release it in the second half of June. With every new country we try to bring into the game some interesting mechanics. With Austria-Hungary the poisoning technology will appear. But it’s not ready yet.

And now we’d like to introduce you some future units.

Austro-Hungarian war engineers raised military artillery to a whole new level.
So let’s start with the wonderful and terrifying by its power "[b]Wonder Emma[/b]".
This heavy weapon is self-propelled and also it can transform into a light artillery and back again. But the player can make the decision to transform Emma into a regular firing position and back again or into a heavy firing position permanently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/5e1adc5f382739f0db0fabeb749e51a50fd8a500.png[/img]


The armoured car "[b]Csaba[/b]" will be available in the First Industrial Revolution and modified in the Second Industrial Revolution.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/db004aae046e4f30f2a150b3f562214dc4a8de04.png[/img]


The light anti-aircraft combat vehicle "[b]Nimrod[/b]" can fight back against light vehicles and also protect from air attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/7f2be8f205ca1ff2e26970c80903da42b2f76225.png[/img]


Hungarian mobile artillery is presented by the legendary self-propelled gun "[b]Zrínyi[/b]". The assault carrier is dangerous both for vehicles and enemy buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34645247/17365c95488f59291163108d729da0f9403eb725.png[/img]
